versions.content: If the return value of the function Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC is DEM _PENDING, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall retrigger Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC (with parameter DTCTypeFilter set to DEM_J1939DTC_CLEAR_PREVIOUSLY_ACTIVE) in the next call of J1939Dcm_MainFunction.

If the return value of the function Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC is DEM _PENDING, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall retrigger Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC (with parameter DTCTypeFilter Specification of a Diagnostic Communication Manager for SAE J1939 AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 30 of 101 Document ID 610 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SAEJ1939DiagnosticCommunicationManager set to DEM_J1939DTC_CLEAR_PREVIOUSLY_ACTIVE) in the next call of J1939Dcm_MainFunction.

If the return value of the function Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC is DEM _PENDING, the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall retrigger Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC (with parameter DTCTypeFilter Specification of a Diagnostic Communication Manager for SAE J1939 AUTOSAR CP R21 - 11 30 of 100 Document ID 610 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SAEJ1939DiagnosticCommunicationManager set to DEM_J1939DTC_CLEAR_PREVIOUSLY_ACTIVE) in the next call of J1939Dcm_MainFunction.
